messages:
customer_janice: Hey team, we've seen our app crash ~5% of streaming responses this morning. The JSON stream cuts off mid-object (missing final brace) and our parser throws. Happening on chat->json mode over SSE. Anyone else?

anna_support: Sorry about that — can you paste a minimal repro (curl) and a truncated payload?

customer_janice: Repro steps:
```
curl -N -H 'Accept: text/event-stream' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-XXXXX' \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-4r","stream":true,"json_mode":true,"prompt":"..."}' \
  https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate
```
Sample received chunk (last bytes):
```
data: {"id":"resp_123","choices":[{"delta":{"content":"{\"user\":\"ok\",\"items\":[\"a\",\"b\",\"c\""},"finish_reason":null}]}
```
(note final ]}\"c\"" no closing braces)

matt_oncall: That looks like an upstream connection close. Any proxy between client and runtime? nginx/cloudflare?

customer_janice: We go through our infra -> cloudflare -> redwood edge. We've seen some 502 spikes around the same time.

liam_infra: Can you grab the client-side TCP trace and share a short pcap/text? Also, try `curl --no-buffer` to avoid libcurl buffering behavior. We suspect an early FIN from the edge.

customer_janice: Attached a short hexdump from the capture — shows TLS records then a TCP FIN about 4s before the stream ends.
```
... TLS record (application data)
... application data: SSE chunk
TCP FIN from 198.51.100.12 -> 203.0.113.7 seq 0 win 0
```

liam_infra: Thanks — that aligns with `upstream prematurely closed connection while reading response header from upstream` in nginx. On our side we saw identical pattern in edge logs: `upstream prematurely closed connection while reading response header from upstream` and some `recv() failed (104: Connection reset by peer)`. Could be keepalive timeout or worker oom-kill on a noisy host.

matt_oncall: Quick mitigation: increase proxy_read_timeout and proxy_send_timeout to 120s for SSE endpoints and set `proxy_buffering off; chunked_transfer_encoding on;` in nginx. Also ensure the runtime flushes a small heartbeat JSON (\"heartbeat\":true) every 10s so clients can detect midstream issues.

deploy-bot: infra:nginx-config updated in staging (PR #4521). Rolling to canary in 10m. :rocket:

liam_infra: If we can reproduce locally: run a small server that sends a few SSE events then sends RST after partial payload to mimic proxy cut. That will reproduce the missing final brace case for JSON-mode consumers. Recording repro steps and adding to support KB.

product_ops: Noted — longer term, we should add streaming integrity metadata (per-event checksum or explicit end-of-object marker) so clients can validate JSON chunks. Adding to backlog.

anna_support: Next steps for customer: 1) try `curl --no-buffer` repro and share full tcpdump, 2) confirm whether canary nginx change fixes it (we'll ping you when rolled), 3) if still failing we'll request a full runtime trace.

customer_janice: Will run steps and report back. Thanks for the fast triage. :pray:
